prompt: What should a resident expect after selecting “both” on the signup sheet?
promptZh: 住戶在登記表選「兩天皆可」後，接下來會怎樣？

options.text: Two visits scheduled in one message
options.zh: 同一則簡訊內安排兩次清潔
options.whyZh: 兩天皆可只是任一天有空，不是要約兩次。

options.text: A visit assigned automatically to Monday morning
options.zh: 自動安排星期一上午清潔
options.whyZh: 公告只說會排一個時段，未保證哪一天或上午。

options.text: A request to choose a day after the crew arrives
options.zh: 等清潔人員到達後才請住戶選日期
options.whyZh: 星期日晚上就會通知，不會到場才選。

options.text: One time sent by text on Sunday evening
options.zh: 星期日晚上收到一則簡訊，通知一個清潔時段
options.whyZh: 選兩天都可仍只排一個時段，通知方式為星期日晚上傳簡訊。

explanationZh: 選兩天都可仍只排一個時段，通知方式為星期日晚上傳簡訊。
evidence: This means you can be home on either day, not that you need two visits. / We will send you one time by text on Sunday evening.

evidenceSpans.exactQuote: This means you can be home on either day, not that you need two visits.
We will send you one time by text on Sunday evening.

vocabulary.note: 兩天當中任選一天，不表示兩次。
